title: bb_health: mutability contract (read vs index)

checks.name: registry: refresh/force described as explicit reindex
docs: refresh/force documented as explicit index mutation
handler: refresh gated on explicit refresh/force flags
runtime: plain health call performs ZERO index mutation [negative]
runtime: plain health call returns a report
runtime: refresh=true explicitly mutates the index [negative]
runtime: force=true performs an explicit in-place reindex

decisions.singleTruth: registry mutability field is the authority; docs/data/public-tools.json and docs/tools/bb_health.md are generated from it and must agree
decisions.explicitMutation: refresh=true / force=true are documented and implemented as explicit index mutation; a plain call must never mutate
decisions.runtimeProof: DB fingerprint (bytes + symbol count) must be identical after a plain call and different after refresh/force

limitations: The fingerprint covers the project DB file; unrelated writes (e.g. shared caches outside the project) are out of scope.
